terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.command: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; bun run dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the Loreweaver Studio frontend on http://localhost:1420 (the WebView half of the Tauri app; the full desktop shell runs via `bun tauri dev` when a display is available).
